messages:
Priya: Heads-up — final onsite for *Candidate Z* Thu 11:00 PT. Need quick confirmation on panel flow: who is scribe, timekeeper, and score-normalizer? planning a 10‑min buffer between slots. Can people reply with one-line availability? :wave:
Samir: I can scribe for round 1 & 2. taking notes in the shared doc. :+1:
Elena: I can timekeep. will join 5m early to load materials.
Aisha: I can do score-normalizer but need the rubric link + any weightings.
Priya: Rubric + eval sheet here: https://docs.redwood.ai/evals/final-debrief-rubric (view only) — please copy to your drive if needed.
Samir: quick Q — are we keeping 10m buffer or extend to 15? Candidate has a 1h takehome discussion.
Elena: keep 10m, but add a 5m transition after second slot for bathroom/tech.
Priya: ok 10m buffer, + 5m transition after slot 2. I'll update calendar blocks.
recruit-bot: Calendar invites sent to panel, zoom link created (passcode: rotated). :robot_face:
Aisha: And for score normalization — do we normalize across panelists or per-round? last time we did per-round.
Priya: normalize per-round, then average. note in debrief: outlier clamp at +/- 1 point.
Samir: adding scribe template to the doc:
```
- Start: 1 min intro
- 40 min question rounds
- 5 min candidate Q
- 10 min buffer
- Debrief: 15 min
```
Elena: tagging lightning items — accessibility needs? candidate asked for captions.
Priya: captions enabled on Zoom, note them in calendar. also add transcript consent step.
Samir: transferring scribe for round 3 to @Elena (I'm OOO 3–4pm).
Elena: got it. I'll take notes for round 3.
Aisha: got rubric copy, will prep normalization table.
Priya: Awesome — final checklist: Scribe: Samir (R1-2), Elena (R3); Timekeeper: Elena; Score-normalizer: Aisha; Buffers: 10m each + 5m mid-run. I'll post final runbook here 1 hour before. :checkered_flag:
Elena: :thumbsup:
Samir: :thumbsup:
Aisha: :thumbsup:
